about_zh: 游戏、模拟器、桌宠和一点纯粹的乐趣。

repos.summary_zh: FMHY 是一个聚合海量免费资源的互联网平台，涵盖软件、工具、学习资料等，提供结构化索引与社区推荐。项目通过 Wiki 维护内容，支持 Markdown/JSON API 备份，强调去中心化存储与社区协作，所有文件均托管于第三方，确保内容自由开放。
repos.summary_en: FMHY is the largest internet platform curating free resources like software, tools, and learning materials, offering structured indexes and community recommendations. It maintains content via a Wiki, supports Markdown/JSON API backups, emphasizes decentralized storage, and operates without hosting files, ensuring open and free access.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一款免费无广告的追剧资源聚合指南，人工精选并每日自动检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等117个资源，完全开源，支持社区共同维护与贡献。
repos.summary_en: A free, ad-free curated guide for streaming resources with manual selection and daily automated validation. Covers online streaming, TV apps, cloud search, torrent/磁力 links, subtitles, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources—117 resources total, fully open-source and community-maintained.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费且无广告的追剧资源导航项目。它通过人工精选与每日自动化检测，收录了涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、TVBox配置及IPTV直播源等80余个高质量资源。项目采用社区共同维护模式，旨在为用户提供纯净、有效且持续更新的影视观看解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free resource guide for tracking dramas and movies. Combining manual curation with daily automated availability checks, it aggregates over 80 high-quality resources including online streaming, apps, cloud storage searches, magnet links, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources. Maintained by the community, it aims to provide a pure, reliable, and continuously updated viewing solution.

repos.description: quick-cocos2d-x is a quick framework, based on cocos2d-x. Make mobile games in Lua.
repos.summary_zh: quick-cocos2d-x 是触控科技基于 cocos2d-x 开发的 Lua 脚本扩展框架，专为移动端游戏快速开发设计。它提供完整的 Lua 脚本支持、高级 UI 库、代码加密与自动更新功能，显著降低开发成本并提升效率，适用于高品质手游产品的敏捷开发。
repos.summary_en: Quick-Cocos2d-x is a Lua-based extension framework built on cocos2d-x by Touch Technology, designed for rapid mobile game development. It offers full Lua scripting support, advanced UI libraries, code encryption, and auto-update features, significantly reducing development costs and accelerating time-to-market for high-quality mobile games.

repos.summary_zh: 该仓库专门收集 V2EX 社区及类似平台上的公开争议事件，涵盖技术争论、价值观冲突、商业纠纷等多元议题，通过存档原始帖子与补充背景资料，系统记录中国互联网技术圈内的公共舆论交锋与社区生态变迁。
repos.summary_en: This repository archives public disputes from V2EX and related platforms, covering technical debates, value conflicts, and business controversies. It systematically documents public discourse and community evolution in China's tech ecosystem through original posts and contextual materials.

repos.description: 创业者的游戏： 中关村启示录
repos.summary_zh: 《创业游戏：中关村启示录》是一款基于Ruby CLI的模拟经营类游戏，玩家通过雇佣程序员、管理资金与项目进度，体验创业公司从0到1的成长过程。支持自定义程序员角色、随机事件与动态交互，社区可提交Pull Request参与开发，具有高度开放性与趣味性。
repos.summary_en: Startup-Game is a CLI-based simulation game written in Ruby, simulating the journey of building a startup from scratch. Players hire coders, manage funds and project progress, and experience the challenges of entrepreneurship. It supports custom coders via Pull Requests, random events, and dynamic gameplay, fostering community-driven development.

repos.summary_zh: 个人影视资源聚合库，整合多平台 UZ 影视资源接口，支持快速检索与在线播放。适合搭建私人媒体中心或作为资源索引参考。仅用于测试娱乐，随时可能删除，不具备长期维护保障。
repos.summary_en: A personal UZ video resource aggregation repository that consolidates multi-platform streaming interfaces for quick search and online playback. Suitable for building a private media center or serving as a resource index reference. Intended for testing and entertainment only, with no long-term maintenance guarantee.
